correctness.rationale: The proof first gives an exact structural characterization of general-position sets in the windmill, then derives the coefficient formula and proves unimodality in the three exhaustive regimes m=1, n=2 with m>=2, and n>=3 with m>=2. Boundary transitions where the petal correction disappears are handled explicitly. Exact enumeration of the smallest four parameter pairs and a 2<=n<=30, 1<=m<=30 arithmetic sweep agree with the theorem and proof inequalities.

originality.rationale: The polynomial formula itself is not claimed as new: it follows from the published join formula in arXiv:2401.05696. The reviewed contribution is the all-parameter unimodality theorem for K_1 join nK_m. Targeted checks of the defining paper, the 2026 explicit-formula follow-up, windmill/friendship/block-graph terminology, and nearby published findings did not reveal an equivalent or stronger theorem. This remains a best-of-knowledge claim rather than an exhaustive bibliographic guarantee.

value.rationale: Unimodality is an active structural question for general position polynomials and fails for some simple graph families. The theorem gives a closed all-parameter positive family among natural chordal/block graphs, simultaneously covering all stars and friendship graphs, with a proof that isolates the coefficient transition responsible for unimodality.
